messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync: GCP private offer + Azure entitlements for the upcoming listing. Need mapping for SKU -> entitlement codes and a short onboarding email. Who picks up entitlements?
Tom (cloud-ops): I can map SKUs to marketplace entitlements. Question: do reserved SKUs require separate entitlement codes per region?
Renee (legal): For compliance, we want region-level entitlements for EU and APAC to flag data residency language. Also need the short EULA blurb for private offers.
Carlos (infra): Technical note: GCP private offers require a partner procurement ID and a signed manifest. I'll add an example manifest and the service account role instructions.
Maya (partnerships): Good. Tom, aim for a simple CSV: sku,entitlement_code,region. Keep region blank for global unless EU/APAC special.
Tom (cloud-ops): Will do. Also recommend a trial_entitlement flag column so marketplace can auto-enable trial.
Renee (legal): Trial blurb: "14-day trial included; charges begin after trial unless canceled. Customer data handled per regional controls." Short and linkable.
Carlos (infra): Manifest example (short): name=redwood-inference,version=1.0,artifact=registry.redwood/release:v1,health=/healthz,regions=global
publish-bot: Entitlement CSV template created and uploaded to /shared/marketplace/entitlements.csv
Maya (partnerships): Nice. Next: onboarding email template. I'll draft quick copy: welcome, link to publisher starter kit, contact marketplace-support@redwood.ai, and steps to upload artifact.
Tom (cloud-ops): After CSV and manifest, I'll coordinate with vendor PMs to request sandbox approval. ETA tomorrow AM.
Renee (legal): I'll attach the one-line legal footnote and confirm privacy addendum link.
Maya (partnerships): Perfect. Action items: Tom creates CSV, Carlos uploads manifest samples, Renee finalizes blurb, Maya drafts onboarding email. We'll hand to vendor PMs once sandbox passed. Thanks! :rocket:
